name: Pelahustán (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, green and white, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Pelahustán (a pillory, a flax plant and two cauldrons).
history: The heraldic arms and the flag were officially approved on 6 May 2003 and published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha of 16 May 2003; the arms are party per pale, the first per fess gules a pillory argent and or a flax plant vert, the second argent two cauldrons indented or and gules, with the royal crown of Spain. The flag is a rectangular cloth of proportions 2:3, divided horizontally into three equal stripes, red above, green in the centre and white below, bearing at the centre the crowned municipal arms.
